# Notes
## Making the ranked dispersion tables
```{r}
# produce gene ranking dataframe
cell_types <- c(
  "Cardiomyocytes", "Mesenchymal_cells", "Cardiac_fibroblasts", 
  "Epithelial_cells", "Activated_fibroblasts", "Foregut_endodermal_cells"
)

## Bin median variability within cell types into quintiles by rank ...................
ct_ranks_df <- as.data.frame(matrix(data = NA,
                      nrow = length(rownames(res_var_df)),
                      ncol = length(cell_types)))
colnames(ct_ranks_df) <- cell_types
rownames(ct_ranks_df) <- rownames(res_var_df)

for (cell_type in cell_types){
  # Build the column names for this cell type across all individuals
  cols <- paste0(c("NA19099_", "NA19093_", "NA18522_"), cell_type)
  
  # Select those columns from res_var_df and take median value
  ct_res_var <- res_var_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(cols))
  median_res_var <- data.frame(med_vals = apply(ct_res_var, 1, function(x) median(x)))
  
  # Rank from lowest to highest
  ranks <- rank(median_res_var, ties.method = "average")
  
  # Fill into the right column (gene order is preserved)
  ct_ranks_df[ , cell_type] <- ranks
}

## Convert ranks into quintiles ...................
n_genes <- nrow(ct_ranks_df)
n_quantiles <- 5

quantile_bins <- apply(ct_ranks_df, 2, function(x) {
  cut(x, 
      breaks = quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_quantiles + 1), na.rm = TRUE), 
      labels = FALSE, 
      include.lowest = TRUE)
})

rownames(quantile_bins) <- rownames(ct_ranks_df)
var_quintile_dfs <- as.data.frame(quantile_bins)
```

```{r}
# make vector of selected samples
samples <- c("NA19099_Cardiomyocytes", "NA18522_Mesenchymal_cells", "NA19093_Cardiac_fibroblasts", "NA19099_Epithelial_cells", "NA19093_Activated_fibroblasts", "NA19093_Foregut_endodermal_cells")
```

```{r}
sample <- samples[1]
  cell_type <- cell_types[1]
  
  clean_cell_type <- gsub("_", " ", cell_type)
    
  ct_res_var <- res_var_df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(sample)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = rownames(.)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(res_var = sample)
    
  ct_mean_var <- mean_df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(sample)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = rownames(.)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(mean = sample)
    
  df <- ct_res_var %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(ct_mean_var, by = "gene")
  
  # Compute Pearson correlation
  cor_test <- cor.test(df$mean, df$res_var, method = "spearman")
  
  rho_val <- round(cor_test$estimate, 4)
  
  # Generate plot
  plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = mean, y = res_var)) +
  geom_point(
    color = viridis(1, option = "C"),
    alpha = 0.2,
    size = 0.4
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0("Spearman ρ = ", rho_val),
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 2  # ~6 pt at final 90 mm size
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
    
    labs(
    title = clean_cell_type
  ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, angle = 90),
      title = element_text(size = 7)
    ) +
    labs(y = "Dispersion",
         x = "Mean")
  
plot
```

## Supp S4
```{r}
samples <- colnames(res_var_df)
# split sample into parts
split_parts <- strsplit(samples, "_")

cell_line <- sapply(split_parts, `[`, 1)
cell_type <- sapply(split_parts, function(x) paste(x[-1], collapse = "_"))

# define desired order
cell_line_order <- c("NA19099", "NA19093", "NA18522")

cell_type_order <- cell_types

# order index
new_order <- order(
  factor(cell_line, levels = cell_line_order),
  factor(cell_type, levels = cell_type_order)
)

samples_reordered <- samples[new_order]

res_var_df <- res_var_df %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(samples_reordered))
```

```{r}
common_ylim = c(-4, 8)
common_xlim = c(-15,0)

plots <- list()

for(i in 1:length(samples_reordered)){
  sample <- samples_reordered[i]
  cell_type <- cell_types[i]
  
  clean_cell_type <- gsub("_", " ", cell_type)
    
  ct_res_var <- res_var_df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(sample)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = rownames(.)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(res_var = sample)
    
  ct_mean_var <- mean_df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(sample)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = rownames(.)) %>%
    dplyr::rename(mean = sample)
    
  df <- ct_res_var %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(ct_mean_var, by = "gene")
  
  # Compute Pearson correlation
  cor_test <- cor.test(df$mean, df$res_var, method = "spearman")
  
  rho_val <- round(cor_test$estimate, 4)
  
  # Generate plot
  plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = mean, y = res_var)) +
  geom_point(
    color = viridis(1, option = "C"),
    alpha = 0.2,
    size = 0.4
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0("Spearman ρ = ", rho_val),
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 2  # ~6 pt at final 90 mm size
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
    
    labs(
    title = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis text
            axis.text.y = element_blank(),  # Remove y-axis text
            #axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis ticks
            #axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),  # Remove y-axis ticks
            plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
            axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.title.y = element_blank()
            ) +
      ylim(common_ylim) +   # Set common y-axis limits
      xlim(common_xlim)  # Set common x-axis limits
  
  # Display cell type for first 6 plots
  if (i == 1 | i == 2 | i == 3 | i == 4 | i == 5 | i == 6) {
    plot <- plot + labs(title = clean_cell_type)
  }
  
    # Display y axis for specific plots
    if (i == 1 | i == 7 | i == 13) {
      plot <- plot + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
                           axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, angle = 90)) +
        labs(y = "Dispersion")
      }
    
    # Display x axis text and x axis title for specific plots
    if (i == 13 | i == 14 | i == 15 | i == 16 | i == 17 | i == 18) {
      plot <- plot + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
                           axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7)) +
        labs(x = "Mean")
    }
# Store the plot in the list
    plots[[sample]] <- plot
}

# Combine all plots into a single grid with 3 columns
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 6, axis_titles = "collect")
```

## A
```{r}
# By sheet name
res_df <- read_excel(paste0(dir, "analysis/first_pub_datasets/Supplementary_table_s2.xlsx"), sheet = "Low_dispersion_GO_enrichment") %>%
  # filter for cluster_resolution == 0.2
  filter(cluster_resolution == "2")
```

```{r}
plot_df <- res_df %>%
  # Match clusterProfiler behavior: smallest p.adjust first
  arrange(p.adjust) %>%
  head(8) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert GeneRatio from "x/y" → numeric
    GeneRatio_num = as.numeric(str_split_fixed(GeneRatio, "/", 2)[,1]) /
                    as.numeric(str_split_fixed(GeneRatio, "/", 2)[,2]),

    # -log10 adjusted p-value
    log10_padj = -log10(p.adjust),

    # Match ordering in dotplot (top = most significant)
    Description = factor(ID, levels = rev(ID))
  )
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = GeneRatio_num, y = Description)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count, color = log10_padj)) +

  # Match color scale
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "grey85",
    high = "#8B0000",
    name = expression(-log[10](adjusted~p))
  ) +

  # Match size scaling feel
  scale_size(range = c(2, 6)) +

  labs(
    title = "GO enrichment: consistently low-dispersed genes",
    x = "Gene ratio",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0.5),

    # Match legend key sizing
    legend.key.height = unit(3, "mm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(3, "mm"),

    # Tight margins like your original
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm"),

    # This is important for matching geometry feel
    aspect.ratio = 2
  )

p
```

## B
```{r}
# Convert from Seurat to Single Cell Experiment
DefaultAssay(brendan_obj) <- "RNA"
sce_obj <- as.SingleCellExperiment(brendan_obj)

# run dreamlet function to split sce object by cell type and individual
assayNames(sce_obj)
colnames(colData(sce_obj))

# Aggregate SCE to pseudo-bulk
pb <- aggregateToPseudoBulk(
  sce_obj,
  assay = "counts",
  sample_id = "vireo.individual",
  cluster_id = "new.predicted.id"
)

# extract the aggr_means data frame from the metadata slot
aggr_means_df <- metadata(pb)$aggr_means
```

```{r}
# subset metadata to res_var samples
aggr_means_df <- aggr_means_df[aggr_means_df$sample_id %in% colnames(res_var_df),]

# reorder metadata rows to match sample order in res_var (columns)
aggr_means_df <- aggr_means_df[match(colnames(res_var_df), aggr_means_df$sample_id), ]

# construct the metadata table
metadata <- data.frame(
  cell_type = factor(rep(unique(aggr_means_df$new.predicted.id), each = 3)),
  cell_line = factor(rep(c("NA19099", "NA19093", "NA18522"), times = 6)),
  nFeatures = scale(aggr_means_df$nFeature_RNA),
  nCount = scale(aggr_means_df$nCount_RNA),
  cell_count = scale(aggr_means_df$cell_num),
  perc_mt = scale(aggr_means_df$percent.mt),
  log_umi = aggr_means_df$log_umi
)
rownames(metadata) <- colnames(res_var_df)

form <- ~ cell_count + nFeatures + perc_mt + (1 | cell_type)

vp_res_var <- fitExtractVarPartModel(res_var_df, form, metadata)
median(vp_res_var$cell_type)
```

## C
```{r}
# load in seurat object if necessary
brendan_obj <- readRDS(paste0(dir, "analysis/datasets/100k_full_filtered_norm_seurat.rds"))
```

```{r}
split_parts <- strsplit(colnames(res_var_df), "_", fixed = TRUE)
cell_type <- sapply(split_parts, function(x) paste(x[-1], collapse = "_"))

cell_types <- unique(cell_type)

cell_counts <- read.csv(paste0(dir, "analysis/datasets/cell_counts_new_pred_id.csv"), row.names = 1)
```

```{r}
cormat <- cor(res_var_df, method = "pearson")

all_individuals <- c("NA19099", "NA19093", "NA18522")

all_cell_types  <- c(
  "Cardiomyocytes",
  "Mesenchymal_cells",
  "Cardiac_fibroblasts",
  "Epithelial_cells",
  "Activated_fibroblasts",
  "Foregut_endodermal_cells"
)

# Extract metadata
individual <- sapply(split_parts, `[`, 1)
cell_type  <- sapply(split_parts, function(x) paste(x[-1], collapse = "_"))

# 🔒 Force stable factor levels
individual <- factor(individual, levels = all_individuals)
cell_type  <- factor(cell_type,  levels = all_cell_types)

# 🔒 Create fixed color mappings
individual_palette <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Paired")
individual_cols <- setNames(individual_palette[seq_along(all_individuals)],
                            all_individuals)

cell_type_palette <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired")
cell_type_cols <- setNames(cell_type_palette[seq_along(all_cell_types)],
                           all_cell_types)

# --- Annotation ---
ha <- columnAnnotation(
  Individual = individual,
  Cell_Type  = cell_type,
  Cell_Count = anno_barplot(
    cell_counts$Freq,
    gp = gpar(fill = "grey30", col = NA),
    border = FALSE
  ),
  col = list(
    Individual = individual_cols,
    Cell_Type  = cell_type_cols
  ),
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontfamily = "Arial"),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontfamily = "Arial"),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    direction = "vertical",
    ncol = 1
  )
)

# --- Heatmap ---
HCheat <- Heatmap(
  cormat,
  top_annotation = ha,
  name = "Correlation",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(
    seq(0.8, 1, length.out = 11),
    inferno(11)
  ),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = TRUE,
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontfamily = "Arial"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontfamily = "Arial"),
    direction = "vertical"
  )
)

res_var_hm <- draw(
  HCheat,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right"
)

res_var_hm
```

## D
```{r}
# By sheet name
dv_de_res <- read_excel(paste0(dir, "analysis/first_pub_datasets/Supplementary_table_s1.xlsx"), sheet = "cardiac_HDC_results") %>%
  # dplyr::select for columns that include "K"
  dplyr::select(contains("K"))

# make a dispersion data frame from dv_de_res by selecting columns that include "dispersion" in the column name
card_dv_res <- dv_de_res %>%
  dplyr::select(contains("dispersion"))

#card_foregut_dv_res <- card_dv_res[,10:12]

# make a mean data frame from dv_de_res by selecting columns that include "mean" in the column name
card_de_res <- dv_de_res %>%
  dplyr::select(contains("mean"))

## RES VAR VS MEAN EFFECT SIZE
plot_df <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(dv_de_res),
  de_logFC = -card_de_res$mean_logFC_K,
  dv_logFC = -card_dv_res$dispersion_logFC_K,
  dv_sig = card_dv_res$dispersion_adj.P.Val_K <= 0.05,
  de_sig = card_de_res$mean_adj.P.Val_K <= 0.05
)

# Plot
# Ensure logical is treated consistently
plot_df$dv_sig <- factor(plot_df$dv_sig, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))

mean_vs_var <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = de_logFC,
                                   y = dv_logFC,

  geom_hline(
```

```{r}
  head(8) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert GeneRatio from "x/y" → numeric
```

```{r}
###########################################
# Set Thresholds #
###########################################
tolerance <- 11847*0.15 #number of positions a gene can change in a cell type wrt global ranking and be kept

n_quantiles <- 5 #number of bins to split genes into for fisher test

###############################################
# MAKE GLOBAL DISPERSION RANKING BY QUINTILES #
###############################################
## Rank median variability within cell types ...................

ct_ranks_df <- as.data.frame(matrix(data = NA,
                      nrow = length(rownames(res_var_df)),
                      ncol = length(cell_types)))
colnames(ct_ranks_df) <- cell_types
rownames(ct_ranks_df) <- rownames(res_var_df)

for (cell_type in cell_types){
  # Build the column names for this cell type across all individuals
  cols <- paste0(c("NA19099_", "NA19093_", "NA18522_"), cell_type)
  
  # Select those columns from res_var_df and take median value
  ct_res_var <- res_var_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(cols))
  median_res_var <- data.frame(med_vals = apply(ct_res_var, 1, function(x) median(x)))
  
  # Rank from lowest to highest
  ranks <- rank(median_res_var, ties.method = "average")
  
  # Fill into the right column (gene order is preserved)
  ct_ranks_df[ , cell_type] <- ranks
}

## Find global ranking of ~commonly ranked genes across cell types ...................

avg_rank <- rowMedians(as.matrix(ct_ranks_df))

filtered_df <- ct_ranks_df[apply(abs(ct_ranks_df - avg_rank) <= tolerance, 1, all), ]

global_ranks_df <- data.frame(global_rank = apply(filtered_df, 1, function(x) median(x)))
global_ranks_df <- data.frame(global_rank = rank(global_ranks_df, ties.method = "average"))
rownames(global_ranks_df) <- rownames(filtered_df)

## Bin into however many bins ...................

#n_quantiles <- 5

decile_bins <- apply(global_ranks_df, 2, function(x) {
  cut(x, 
      breaks = quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_quantiles + 1), na.rm = TRUE), 
      labels = FALSE, 
      include.lowest = TRUE)
})

rownames(decile_bins) <- rownames(global_ranks_df)
var_decile_df <- as.data.frame(decile_bins)
var_decile_df <- var_decile_df %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")
############################
# FISHERS TEST IN EACH BIN #
############################
plot_df <- data.frame(quintile = as.integer(),
                      egene_count = as.integer(),
                      p.value = as.numeric(),
                      log2OR = as.numeric(),
                      log2_ci_lower = as.numeric(),
                      log2_ci_upper = as.numeric())
#i = 1
for(i in seq_along(1:n_quantiles)){
  var_decile_df$qoi <- var_decile_df$global_rank == i
  
  background_genes <- var_decile_df$gene
  quint_genes <- var_decile_df$gene[var_decile_df$qoi == TRUE]
  egenes <- intersect(all_egenes,background_genes)
  
  a <- length(intersect(egenes, quint_genes))
  b <- length(setdiff(egenes, quint_genes))
  c <- length(setdiff(quint_genes, egenes))
  d <- length(setdiff(background_genes, union(egenes, quint_genes)))

contingency <- matrix(
  c(a, b, c, d),
  nrow = 2,
  byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(
    egene = c("Yes", "No"),
    quint_gene = c("In_Set", "Not_In_Set")
  )
)
  
  ft <- fisher.test(contingency)
  egene_count <- a
  
  plot_df <- rbind(plot_df, 
                   data.frame(quintile = i, 
                              egene_count = egene_count, 
                              p.value = ft[["p.value"]],
                              OR = unname(ft$estimate),
                              ci_lower = ft$conf.int[1],
                              ci_upper = ft$conf.int[2],
                              log2OR = log2(unname(ft$estimate)),
                              log2_ci_lower = log2(ft$conf.int[1]),
                              log2_ci_upper = log2(ft$conf.int[2])))
}

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    quintile = factor(quintile, levels = sort(unique(quintile)))
  )

plot_df$padj <- p.adjust(plot_df$p.value, method = "BH")

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    label = ifelse(
      quintile == levels(quintile)[1] & p.value < 0.05,
      paste0("p = ", format(p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)),
      NA
    )
  )

plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = quintile, y = log2OR)) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = log2_ci_lower, ymax = log2_ci_upper),
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(color = p.value < 0.05),
    size = 1.8
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_nudge(y = 1),
    size = 2,
    family = "Arial"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "black",
               "TRUE"  = "#B22222"),   # deep firebrick red
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Dispersion (global quintile rank)",
    y = expression(log[2]("Odds ratio")),
    title = "Enrichment of eGenes across dispersion quintiles"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm")
  )

plot
```

```{r}
ct_specific_twn_percentage_func <- function(cell_type, sheet, percentage) {
  # 1. Get the ct-specific rankings for cell type of interest
  low <- percentage*length(rownames(ct_ranks_df))
  high <- length(rownames(ct_ranks_df)) - percentage*length(rownames(ct_ranks_df))
  
  ## lowest dispersed genes of cell type ...................
  low_disp <- ct_ranks_df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(cell_type)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(if_all(everything(), ~.x <= low)) %>%
    rownames()
  
  ## highest dispersion genes of cell type
  high_disp <- ct_ranks_df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(cell_type)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(if_all(everything(), ~.x >= high)) %>%
    rownames()
  
  # 2. Load the TWN table
  TE_TE <- readxl::read_excel(paste0(dir, "analysis/datasets/external_data/saha_coexp_net_TWN_2017/Supplemental_Data_S2.xlsx"), sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE)
  colnames(TE_TE) <- c("hub_name", "n_genes", "genes")
  
  # 3. Build dataframe containing only genes that are TWN hubs and are in 1st and 5th quintiles
  df <- data.frame(
    genes = c(low_disp, high_disp)
    #genes = never_first_fifth_genes
    )
  
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(genes %in% TE_TE$hub_name) %>%
    mutate(rank_category = case_when(
    genes %in% low_disp  ~ "low",
    genes %in% high_disp ~ "high"
    )) %>%
    #dplyr::mutate(enh_length = abc_df$avg_length_across_celltype[match(genes, abc_df$TargetGene)]) %>%
    #dplyr::mutate(tss_count = tss_df$Freq[match(genes, tss_df$Var1)])
    dplyr::mutate(n_genes = as.integer(TE_TE$n_genes[match(genes, TE_TE$hub_name)]))
  
  df$rank_category <- factor(df$rank_category, levels = c("low", "high"), ordered = TRUE)
  
  # 4. Plot
  twn_hub_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = rank_category, y = n_genes, fill = rank_category)) +
    
    geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.format",
    size = 2
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "low" = "steelblue",
      "high" = "coral"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "low" = "Low-dispersion\ngenes",
      "high" = "High-dispersion\ngenes"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Connections per gene"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
  text = element_text(size = 6),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
  axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
  axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
  legend.position = "none",
  plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm"),
  panel.border = element_rect(
    colour = "black",
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 0.4
  )
)
  
  return(twn_hub_plot)
}
```

```{r}
window_size <- 1500
step_size <- 100

cell_types <- c("Cardiomyocytes", "Cardiac_fibroblasts", "Activated_fibroblasts", "Foregut_endodermal_cells")
cell_type <- "Cardiomyocytes"
plots <- list()
cell_type <- cell_types[1]
for (cell_type in cell_types){
  # read in eGenes for this cell type
  egenes <- read_table(paste0("/project/gilad/emcintire/chemo_project_2023/pipeline/map_eqtls/archive/no_cvrt_condox_only/eqtl_results/Control/", cell_type, "/steadyState_", cell_type, "_Control_AllChroms.txt")) #uses readr function. regards all white space as delimiter
  
  egenes <- egenes %>%
    dplyr::filter(bh_adj_pvalue <= 0.05)
  # Build the column names for this cell type across all individuals
  cols <- paste0(c("NA19099_", "NA19093_", "NA18522_"), cell_type)
  
  # Select those columns from res_var_df and take median value
  ct_res_var <- res_var_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(cols))
  median_res_var <- data.frame(med_vals = apply(ct_res_var, 1, function(x) median(x)))
  
  # subset egenes dataframe to only include genes represented in ct_res_var
  egenes <- egenes[egenes$gene %in% rownames(ct_res_var),]
  egenes <- unique(egenes$gene)
  
  # Rank from lowest to highest (change decreasing=TRUE if needed)
  rank_df <- apply(median_res_var, 2, function(x) rank(x, ties.method = "average"))
  
  # Initialize output
  results <- data.frame(start = integer(), end = integer(), proportion_egenes = numeric(), genes_in_window = integer(), egenes_in_window = integer())
  
  # Get total number of genes to define maximum rank
  max_rank <- nrow(rank_df)
  
  # Sliding window loop
  for (start in seq(1, max_rank - window_size + 1, by = step_size)) {
    end <- start + window_size - 1
    
    # Identify genes ranked within [start, end] in all 3 individuals
    in_window <- apply(rank_df, 1, function(ranks) all(ranks >= start & ranks <= end))
    genes_in_all <- rownames(rank_df)[in_window]
    
    # Count eGenes in that set
    num_egenes <- sum(genes_in_all %in% egenes)
    proportion <- if (length(genes_in_all) > 0) num_egenes / length(genes_in_all) else NA
    #beta_mean <- mean(egenes$beta[egenes$gene %in% genes_in_all])
    
    # Store results
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(start = start, end = end, proportion_egenes = proportion, genes_in_window = length(genes_in_all), egenes_in_window = num_egenes))
  }
  
  results$midpoint <- (results$start + results$end) / 2
  
  # Set parameters for generation of null distribution
  set.seed(123)
  n_permutations <- 15
  
  # Store all null proportions: rows = permutations, columns = windows
  n_windows <- nrow(results)
  null_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_permutations, ncol = n_windows)
  
  # Precompute eligible gene set
  all_genes <- rownames(rank_df)
  
  for (i in 1:n_permutations) {
    # Random "eGenes"
    random_egenes <- sample(all_genes, length(egenes), replace = FALSE)
    tmp_results <- c()
    
    for (w in seq_len(n_windows)) {
      start <- results$start[w]
      end <- results$end[w]
      
      # Which genes are ranked within this window for ALL 3 individuals?
      in_window <- apply(rank_df, 1, function(ranks) all(ranks >= start & ranks <= end))
      genes_in_all <- rownames(rank_df)[in_window]
      
      if (length(genes_in_all) > 0) {
        prop <- sum(genes_in_all %in% random_egenes) / length(genes_in_all)
        } else {
          prop <- NA
          }
      tmp_results <- c(tmp_results, prop)
      }
    null_matrix[i, ] <- tmp_results
    }
  
  # Compute null mean and 95% CI for each window
  results$null_mean <- colMeans(null_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
  results$null_lower <- apply(null_matrix, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  results$null_upper <- apply(null_matrix, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Rescale mean expression to fit within the 0–0.6 y-axis range
 # prop_min <- min(results$proportion_egenes)
 # prop_max <- max(results$proportion_egenes)
  #expr_min <- min(egenes$beta)
  #expr_max <- max(egenes$beta)
  
  #prop_min <- 0
  #prop_max <- 0.015
  #expr_min <- -3
  #expr_max <- 3
  
  # This rescales to proportion scale for plotting
  #results$mean_beta_window_rescaled <- prop_min + 
   # (results$mean_beta_window - expr_min) * (prop_max - prop_min) / (expr_max - expr_min)
  
  ### ORIGINAL PLOT
  plot <- ggplot(results, aes(x = midpoint, y = proportion_egenes)) +
    geom_line(color = "red", size = 0.6) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = null_lower, ymax = null_upper), fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = null_mean), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    ylim(0, 0.02) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = paste0(cell_type)
      ) +
    theme(title = element_text(size = 6)) +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
    text = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(
    colour = "black",
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ))
  
  # Display y axis for specific plots
    if (cell_type == "Cardiomyocytes" | cell_type == "Activated_fibroblasts") {
      plot <- plot + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
                           axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, angle = 90)) +
        labs(y = "Proportion of eGenes")
      }
    
    # Display x axis text and x axis title for specific plots
    if (cell_type == "Activated_fibroblasts" | cell_type == "Foregut_endodermal_cells") {
      plot <- plot + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
                           axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7)) +
        labs(x = "Rank Window Midpoint")
    }
  plots[[cell_type]] <- plot
}

# Combine all plots into a single grid with 3 columns
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, axis_titles = "collect")
```

```{r}
##################################
# READ IN LFSR and premash betas #
##################################
lfsr <- read.csv(paste0(dir, "analysis/datasets/erik_egenes/mash_qtl_lfsr_05"), row.names = 1)

premash_beta <- read.csv(paste0(dir, "analysis/datasets/erik_egenes/premash_betas"), row.names = 1)

window_size <- 3000
step_size <- 100

# Set LFSR threshold for eQTL significance
lfsr_thresh <- 0.05

plots <- list()

for (cell_type in cell_types){
  # From the lfsr dataframe, select the control columns, then filter by lfsr threshold for get sig egenes
  lfsr_col <- paste0(cell_type, "_Control_lfsr")
  beta_col <- paste0(cell_type, "_Control_premash_beta")
  egenes <- lfsr %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(lfsr[[lfsr_col]] < lfsr_thresh) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, all_of(lfsr_col))
  
  # Filter the beta df by the egenes in lfsr
  ct_beta <- premash_beta %>%
    filter(rownames(.) %in% egenes$gene) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, all_of(beta_col))
  
  # Build the column names for this cell type across all individuals
  cols <- paste0(c("NA19099_", "NA19093_", "NA18522_"), cell_type)
  
  # Select those columns from res_var_df and take median value
  ct_res_var <- res_var_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(cols))
  median_res_var <- data.frame(med_vals = apply(ct_res_var, 1, function(x) median(x)))
  
  # subset egenes dataframe to only include genes represented in ct_res_var
  egenes <- egenes[egenes$gene %in% rownames(ct_res_var),]
  ct_beta <- ct_beta[ct_beta$gene %in% egenes$gene,]
  
  # Rank from lowest to highest (change decreasing=TRUE if needed)
  rank_df <- apply(median_res_var, 2, function(x) rank(x, ties.method = "average"))
  
  # Initialize output
  results <- data.frame(start = integer(), end = integer(), genes_in_window = integer(), proportion_egenes = numeric(), egenes_in_window = integer(), median_beta_in_window = integer())
  
  # Get total number of genes to define maximum rank
  max_rank <- nrow(rank_df)
  
  # Sliding window loop
  for (start in seq(1, max_rank - window_size + 1, by = step_size)) {
    end <- start + window_size - 1
    
    # Identify genes ranked within [start, end] in all 3 individuals
    in_window <- apply(rank_df, 1, function(ranks) all(ranks >= start & ranks <= end))
    genes_in_all <- rownames(rank_df)[in_window]
    
    # Count mean beta in that set
    median_beta <- median(abs(ct_beta[[beta_col]][ct_beta$gene %in% genes_in_all]))
    num_egenes <- sum(genes_in_all %in% egenes$gene)
    proportion <- if (length(genes_in_all) > 0) num_egenes / length(genes_in_all) else NA
    
    # Store results
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(start = start, end = end, genes_in_window = length(genes_in_all), proportion_egenes = proportion, egenes_in_window = num_egenes, median_beta_in_window = median_beta))
  }
  
  results$midpoint <- (results$start + results$end) / 2
  
  # Set parameters for generation of null distribution
  set.seed(123)
  n_permutations <- 15
  
  # Store all null proportions: rows = permutations, columns = windows
  n_windows <- nrow(results)
  null_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_permutations, ncol = n_windows)
  
  # Precompute eligible gene set
  all_genes <- rownames(rank_df)
  
  for (i in 1:n_permutations) {
    # Random "eGenes"
    random_egenes <- sample(all_genes, length(egenes$gene), replace = FALSE)
    tmp_results <- c()
    
    for (w in seq_len(n_windows)) {
      start <- results$start[w]
      end <- results$end[w]
      
      # Which genes are ranked within this window for ALL 3 individuals?
      in_window <- apply(rank_df, 1, function(ranks) all(ranks >= start & ranks <= end))
      genes_in_all <- rownames(rank_df)[in_window]
      
      if (length(genes_in_all) > 0) {
        prop <- sum(genes_in_all %in% random_egenes) / length(genes_in_all)
        } else {
          prop <- NA
          }
      tmp_results <- c(tmp_results, prop)
      }
    null_matrix[i, ] <- tmp_results
    }
  
  # Compute null mean and 95% CI for each window
  results$null_mean <- colMeans(null_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
  results$null_lower <- apply(null_matrix, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  results$null_upper <- apply(null_matrix, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Rescale mean expression to fit within the 0–0.6 y-axis range
 # prop_min <- min(results$proportion_egenes)
 # prop_max <- max(results$proportion_egenes)
  #expr_min <- min(egenes$beta)
  #expr_max <- max(egenes$beta)
  
  prop_min <- 0.04
  prop_max <- 0.15
  beta_min <- .3
  beta_max <- .7
  
  # This rescales to proportion scale for plotting
  results$median_beta_in_window_rescaled <- prop_min + 
    (results$median_beta_in_window - beta_min) * (prop_max - prop_min) / (beta_max - beta_min)
  
  plot <- ggplot(results, aes(x = midpoint)) +
    # eGene proportion (primary axis)
    
    geom_line(
      aes(y = proportion_egenes),
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 0.6
      ) +
    
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = null_lower, ymax = null_upper), fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.5) +
    
    geom_line(aes(y = null_mean), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    
    # Effect size (rescaled, secondary axis)
    
    # geom_line(
    #   aes(y = median_beta_in_window_rescaled),
    #   color = "blue",
    #   linewidth = 1.2,
    #   linetype = "dashed"
    #   ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "eGene proportion"
      # sec.axis = sec_axis(
      #   ~ beta_min + (. - prop_min) * (beta_max - beta_min) / (prop_max - prop_min),
      #   name = "Median |effect size| (beta)"
      #   )
      ) +
    
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = cell_type
      ) +
    
    theme(title = element_text(size = 6)) +
    theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
    
    theme(

    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(
    colour = "black",
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ))
  
  # Display y axis for specific plots
    if (cell_type == "Cardiomyocytes" | cell_type == "Epithelial_cells") {
      plot <- plot + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
                           axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, angle = 90)) +
        labs(y = "Proportion of eGenes")

    # Display x axis text and x axis title for specific plots
    if (cell_type == "Epithelial_cells" | cell_type == "Activated_fibroblasts" | cell_type == "Foregut_endodermal_cells") {
      plot <- plot + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
                           axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7)) +
        labs(x = "Rank Window Midpoint")
    }
  plots[[cell_type]] <- plot
}
```

```{r}
ct_specific_twn_percentage_func <- function(cell_type, sheet, percentage) {
  # 1. Get the ct-specific rankings for cell type of interest
  low <- percentage*length(rownames(ct_ranks_df))
  high <- length(rownames(ct_ranks_df)) - percentage*length(rownames(ct_ranks_df))
  
  ## lowest dispersed genes of cell type ...................
  low_disp <- ct_ranks_df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(cell_type)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(if_all(everything(), ~.x <= low)) %>%
    rownames()
  
  ## highest dispersion genes of cell type
  high_disp <- ct_ranks_df %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(cell_type)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(if_all(everything(), ~.x >= high)) %>%
    rownames()
  
  # 2. Load the TWN table
  TE_TE <- readxl::read_excel(paste0(dir, "analysis/datasets/external_data/saha_coexp_net_TWN_2017/Supplemental_Data_S2.xlsx"), sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE)
  colnames(TE_TE) <- c("hub_name", "n_genes", "genes")
  
  # 3. Build dataframe containing only genes that are TWN hubs and are in 1st and 5th quintiles
  df <- data.frame(
    genes = c(low_disp, high_disp)
    #genes = never_first_fifth_genes
    )
  
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(genes %in% TE_TE$hub_name) %>%
    mutate(rank_category = case_when(
    genes %in% low_disp  ~ "low",
    genes %in% high_disp ~ "high"
    )) %>%
    #dplyr::mutate(enh_length = abc_df$avg_length_across_celltype[match(genes, abc_df$TargetGene)]) %>%
    #dplyr::mutate(tss_count = tss_df$Freq[match(genes, tss_df$Var1)])
    dplyr::mutate(n_genes = as.integer(TE_TE$n_genes[match(genes, TE_TE$hub_name)]))
  
  df$rank_category <- factor(df$rank_category, levels = c("low", "high"), ordered = TRUE)
  
  # 4. Plot
  twn_hub_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = rank_category, y = n_genes, fill = rank_category)) +
    
    geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.format",
    size = 2
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "low" = "steelblue",
      "high" = "coral"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "low" = "Low-dispersion\ngenes",
      "high" = "High-dispersion\ngenes"
    )
  ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0,80)
    ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Connections per gene"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
  text = element_text(size = 6),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
  axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
  axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
  legend.position = "none",
  plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm"),
  panel.border = element_rect(
    colour = "black",
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 0.4
  )
)
  
  return(twn_hub_plot)
}
```

```{r}
epd_tata <- read.table("/project/gilad/brendan/dispersion/pilot/cHDC_data/cellranger_cluster-mode_trial/analysis/datasets/external_data/epd/human_epdnew_3sa0y.bed", sep = "\t", header = FALSE)

# rename columns
colnames(epd_tata) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "promoter_id", "score", "strand")

# make new column indicating gene
epd_tata <- epd_tata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    gene = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", promoter_id)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    promoter_number = as.integer(sub("^.*_", "", promoter_id))
    )

tata_enrich_func <- function(target_genes){
  background_genes <- rownames(var_quintile_dfs)
  tata_genes <- intersect(unique(epd_tata$gene),background_genes)
  
  a <- length(intersect(tata_genes, target_genes))
  b <- length(setdiff(tata_genes, target_genes))
  c <- length(setdiff(target_genes, tata_genes))
  d <- length(setdiff(background_genes, union(tata_genes, target_genes)))
  
  contingency <- matrix(
    c(a, b, c, d),
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(
      TATA = c("Yes", "No"),
      Target = c("In_Set", "Not_In_Set")
      )
    )
  ft <- fisher.test(contingency)
  return(ft)
}

# Fisher's exact TEST
# will use the first, fifth, and never gene sets as the target gene set
background_genes <- rownames(var_quintile_dfs)
target_genes <- var_first_quint_genes
tata_genes <- intersect(unique(epd_tata$gene),background_genes)

a <- length(intersect(tata_genes, target_genes))
b <- length(setdiff(tata_genes, target_genes))
c <- length(setdiff(target_genes, tata_genes))
d <- length(setdiff(background_genes, union(tata_genes, target_genes)))

contingency <- matrix(
  c(a, b, c, d),
  nrow = 2,
  byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(
    TATA = c("Yes", "No"),
    Target = c("In_Set", "Not_In_Set")
  )
)

contingency

#chisq.test(contingency)
ft <- fisher.test(contingency)
```

```{r}
mart <- useEnsembl("ensembl",dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

## get MANE select transcripts and other information, then filter for your genes
BM.mane <- getBM(
  attributes = c(
    "ensembl_gene_id",
    "ensembl_transcript_id",
    "hgnc_symbol",
    "transcript_mane_select",
    "refseq_mrna"
  ),
  filters = "mane_select",
  values = TRUE,       # TRUE returns only MANE Select transcripts
  mart = mart
)

BM.mane <- subset(BM.mane, hgnc_symbol %in% rownames(ct_ranks_df))

## get the ensembl_transcript_id here to subset for the exon dataset, then make the exon dataset
transcript_ids <- unique(BM.mane$ensembl_transcript_id)
exon.info <- getBM(attributes=c("ensembl_gene_id", "ensembl_transcript_id", "ensembl_exon_id", "exon_chrom_start", "exon_chrom_end"),
                   filters = "ensembl_transcript_id",
                   values = transcript_ids,
                   mart=mart)

exon.info <- exon.info %>%
  left_join(BM.mane %>% dplyr::select(ensembl_transcript_id, hgnc_symbol, transcript_mane_select),
            by = "ensembl_transcript_id")

## count exons per transcript
exon_counts <- exon.info %>%
  group_by(ensembl_transcript_id, ensembl_gene_id) %>%
  summarise(num_exons = n_distinct(ensembl_exon_id)) %>%
  ungroup()

## add introns (subtract 1 from exon count)
exon_counts <- exon_counts %>%
  mutate(num_introns = num_exons - 1)

## add back in the hgnc symbol column from BM.info.canon
BM.mane.unique <- BM.mane %>%
  distinct(ensembl_transcript_id, hgnc_symbol)

exon_counts <- exon_counts %>%
  left_join(BM.mane.unique %>% dplyr::select(ensembl_transcript_id, hgnc_symbol),
            by = "ensembl_transcript_id")

exon_counts_ordered <- exon_counts %>%
  arrange(desc(num_exons))
```
